dataset.variant: adult male, whole central nervous system (brain, optic lobes, ventral nerve cord)
dataset.dataset_name: Janelia FlyEM Male CNS connectome (MaleCNS) v1.0
dataset.dataset_version: v1.0 flat connectome export, synapse confidence >= 0.5
dataset.citation: Berg, S., Beckett, I.R., Costa, M., Schlegel, P., Januszewski, M., Marin, E.C., Nern, A., ... Jefferis, G.S.X.E. (2025). Sexual dimorphism in the complete connectome of the Drosophila male central nervous system. bioRxiv. https://doi.org/10.1101/2025.10.09.680999 (Cell 2026, https://www.cell.com/cell/fulltext/S0092-8674(26)00942-6). Janelia FlyEM.
dataset.license: CC BY 4.0 (Janelia FlyEM: "The Male CNS dataset is licensed under CC-BY")

converted_from.role: body annotations (class, superclass, type, subclass, nerves, receptor, sides)

notes: nodes: every body with a non-null `superclass` annotation (Janelia's neuron set), id = bodyId as a decimal string; bytewise node ordering
source_type = annotation `class` verbatim (null where Janelia gives none)
side = somaSide, or rootSide when somaSide is null (sensory afferents have no soma in the volume); L, R, M or null
category = `key=value` pairs joined by `;` in the order superclass, type, subclass, nerve (entryNerve, else exitNerve), receptor (receptorType), neuromere (somaNeuromere); null columns skipped
edges: weight rows with both bodies in the node set and weight >= 5; weight = synapse count at confidence >= 0.5 as exported; 33 self-loops kept
all edges chemical; the export does not distinguish gap junctions
